newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - UK retail price data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - UK retail price data.

text.p: Following is a selection of analysts' reactions to data showing British retail prices rose 2.6 percent in the year to May and rose 2.5 excluding mortgage interest payments.

"Even though the headline inflation picture is still quite good...we still have this underlying concern, mainly service sector inflation is still outstripping inflation elsewhere. That's going to conintue to worry the Bank of England committeee."

PHILIP SHAW, UNION PLC: "The numbers are a little bit disappointing given hopes that sterling's strength would lead to a further decline in underlying inflation. The data also show the continued difference between subdued goods price inflation and robust prices in the service sector."

"The reason for the headline pickup is quite likely to do with the erratic items. I wouldn't be particularly worried by that and that trend may continue over the next few months. I think the key issue really is the targeted rate, which stays at 2.5 percent. Basically a neutral to positive for the markets."
